title: Native coefficient hearts and normalized open/proper forgetting
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$ put $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$ and let $g_T$ be geometric Galois Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Let $R_T$ on the small pro-etale site be the sheaf of continuous $\Omega$-valued functions taking values locally in a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Put $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $P_T=g_T^*$, $\mathcal B_T=\mathcal A_T^{P_T}$, whose objects are $(M,\theta:P_TM\xrightarrow{\sim}M)$ and arrows intertwine $\theta$ [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Write $U_T$ for the forgetful functor and also its termwise derived functor on ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal C_T\subset D(\mathcal A_T)$ for objects with bounded cohomology admitting a finite locally closed stratification with pro-etale locally finite free restrictions, and $\mathcal W(T_0)=U_T^{-1}(\mathcal C_T)\subset D(\mathcal B_T)$, with full subcategory morphisms. These are the actual native categories of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated of finite type between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, with geometric fiber $f:X\to Y$. Choose the native compactification $f_0=p_0j_0$ and its geometric fiber $f=pj$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].

The coefficient ring $B_{T_0}$ of locally finite-dimensional-span functions in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework] is canonically $R_T$, respecting restrictions, multiplication and finite-extension inclusions; its internal module objects identify with sectionwise $R_T$-module sheaves with identical actions. The categories $\mathcal A_T$ and $\mathcal B_T$ are Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Site reindexing by $g_T$ and $g_T^{-1}$ gives inverse exact coefficient-preserving equivalences $P_T$ and $P_T^{-1}$. The functor $U_T$ is exact and conservative, has the exact free-action left adjoint with underlying object $\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}P_T^nM$, preserves K-injective complexes [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], and $D(U_T)$ is conservative, commutes with cohomology and shifts, and preserves cone triangles. Thus boundedness and the stated constructibility are tested after forgetting.

Open extension by zero is exact and its native lift forgets to ordinary $j_!$. For proper pushforward let $a:P_Yp_*\xrightarrow{\sim}p_*P_{\overline X}$ be the native Frobenius comparison, so its fixed-pair lift is $(M,\theta)\mapsto(p_*M,p_*(\theta)a_M)$. Put $F^{\mathrm W}=Rp_*^{\mathrm W}j_!^{\mathrm W}$ on ordinary native derived categories and $F^c=Rp_*j_!$. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$c^0:U_YF^{\mathrm W}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^cU_X.$$
Its proper factor is the total-right-derived comparison induced by the equality on sheaf functors, including their derived-unit maps. On a native K-injective resolution $I$ after open extension it is the identity of $Q(p_*U_{\overline X}I)$, where $Q$ is localization; on that representative both Frobenius maps are $Q(p_*(\theta_I)a_{UI})$. Consequently $c^0$ respects the induced Frobenius actions, shifts and all localized derived morphisms. It compares the actual ordered open/proper constructions; it assumes no exceptional adjoint.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-locally-finite-coefficient-ring-realization] on each geometric fibre $T$. Its coefficient isomorphism identifies the finite-extension coefficient sheaf $R_T$ with the native $B_{T_0}$, and its naturality square identifies restriction and geometric coefficient maps. In particular multiplication and the inclusions of finite coefficient fields agree, not merely the underlying abelian sheaves.

source.place: Native coefficient identification preceding the Frobenius-equivariance construction; the existing coefficient-realization lemma supplies the function-sheaf comparison.

proof.text: Unpack an internal $B$-module action in sheaves of $\underline\Omega$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. By [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and the sheafification universal property [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], a map $B\otimes_{\underline\Omega}M\to M$ is exactly a restriction-compatible family of $\underline\Omega(V)$-balanced bilinear maps $B(V)\times M(V)\to M(V)$. The unit and associativity diagrams say $1m=m$ and $(bb')m=b(b'm)$ on sections. Conversely a sectionwise $B(V)$-module action supplies these maps, after restricting scalars along $\underline\Omega\to B$. The two assignments are inverse; the morphism condition in the same definition is precisely sectionwise $B(V)$-linearity. Hence the module presentations, actions and forgetful functors agree. In Lean the existing normalized nativeToOrdinaryModules composite is an equivalence by nativeScalarForgetting_isEquivalence [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-equivalence], scalar restriction along the coefficient isomorphism, and nativeOrdinaryPresentation. Its underlying sheaf equation is definitional.

source.place: Tensor product, label section-tensor-product (03EK), and sheafification, label lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules (03CY); direct unpacking of the module-object axioms.

proof.text: For the actual native hearts, use the existing AdicSheaf.isGrothendieckAbelian instance from SixFunctors/ProEtale/Adic/Module.lean and the native frobeniusPullback equivalence instance from WeilSheaf/Category.lean [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Exactness follows from equivalence of abelian categories. The explicit inverse reindexing is the inverse of adicLowerStarEquivalence for geometricGaloisFrobenius.symm; its functor is definitionally frobeniusPullback. Thus no separate action-site or coefficient-presentation comparison is required for these native structural clauses.

source.place: AdicSheaf Grothendieck instance; frobeniusPullback and its equivalence instance; adicLowerStarEquivalence.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-fixed-pair-derived-forget-comparison] with $\mathcal C=\mathcal A_T$ and $F=P_T$. Its hypotheses hold by Step 3. It gives Grothendieck abelianness of $\mathcal B_T$, exact conservative $U_T$, the exact free-action left adjoint $M\mapsto\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}P_T^nM$ with shifting structure, preservation of K-injectives and conservativity of $D(U_T)$. Exactness gives $U_T\ker d=\ker(U_Td)$ and preserves images and their quotients, so $H^a(D(U_T)K)=U_TH^a(K)$ naturally. By [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated], $D(U_T)$ also commutes with shifts and takes cone triangles to distinguished triangles. Since $U_T$ reflects zero objects, vanishing in each degree, hence boundedness, is tested after forgetting.

source.place: Free.preservesHomology_functor, preservesKInjectiveComplexes_forget; derived conservativity in IsoAlgebraComp.lean; termwise exactness for cohomology and triangles.

proof.text: The geometric fibre is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by base change [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change, lem-pc-separated-quasi-separated]. Apply [lem-sf-native-adic-qcqs-stratification] to turn each native constructible cohomology sheaf into a finite stratified lisse sheaf, then transport across (U.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso n).app K. Conversely transport a stratified lisse sheaf back along the inverse homology comparison, and apply IsAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf.isAdicConstructibleSheaf from the native framework [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Combine this with bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj and bounded_of_bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj from Step 4. The converse uses the existing stratified predicate, which already retains constructible images; no Noetherian-space constructibility argument is needed.

For the actual native open functor [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], use the existing finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances for adicOpenImmersionLowerShriek and its fixed-pair lift extensionByZero. The composite extensionByZero followed by forgetting is definitionally forgetting followed by adicOpenImmersionLowerShriek. The exact derived comparison is (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm, followed by mapDerivedCategoryNatIso of mapOfNatIsoCompForgetIso, followed by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. Thus the previously proved native open-extension API supplies this step directly, without a new abstract localized-module argument.

source.place: ProEtaleWeilSheaf.extensionByZero and its exactness instances; exact-functor derived composition and natural-isomorphism comparisons.

proof.text: Use the actual adicLowerStar and its fixed-pair lift lowerStar from the native framework [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. The source already supplies their additive and left-exact structures. Define d to be the existing rightDerivedFunctorMapOfNatIsoCompForgetIso, whose four factors are the exact-right composition comparison, derivation of mapOfNatIsoCompForgetIso, the composition comparison for forgetting followed by adicLowerStar, and the identification of derived forgetting with exact localization [lem-sf-fixed-pair-derived-forget-comparison]. This is the comparison of the actual functors, rather than a new chosen isomorphism. Neither its construction nor the normalization below needs finite-type hypotheses on the middle scheme.

source.place: rightDerivedFunctorMapOfNatIsoCompForgetIso, canonical comparison of the two total right derived functors.

proof.text: Prove proper_normalization directly for the canonical d, retaining the arrows leftUnit and rightUnit of [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-exact-square-comparison]. In the fully proved private fixedPair_unit_normalization lemma, apply rightDerivedNatTrans_app to the exact-right composition comparison, the strict forgetting isomorphism, and the derived composition comparison. Their unit equations cancel the homotopy composition identifications. The equation rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac then changes the last composite to the inverse exact-localization factor, giving leftUnit I followed by d_QI equals rightUnit I for every complex I. On a K-injective I the native unit is invertible; forgetting preserves K-injectives by Step 4, so the ordinary unit is invertible too [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. This proves both isomorphism clauses. The theorem proper_frobenius follows separately by applying Q.map to equal complex maps and using extensionality in each degree: the fixed-pair lift structure is definitionally a followed by adicLowerStar of theta.

source.place: rightDerivedFunctorMapOfNatIsoCompForgetIso and the unit equations of its four factors; mapOfNatIso_obj_str.

proof.text: The proved compactificationComparison_commShift assembles the canonical shift comparisons of the four proper factors and the exact open comparison. The proved compactificationComparison_frobenius specializes nativeWeil_comparison_structure, whose comparison and ordinary exchange agree definitionally with the specified constructions. Combine these two components with the naturality of compactificationComparison to obtain open_proper.

lean.statement: theorem open_proper (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (c : Compactification f) : (compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.CommShift ℤ ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X), (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map ((compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.app K) ≫ (ordinaryCompactSupportFrobenius (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c K).hom = (nativeCompactSupportFrobenius (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c K).hom ≫ (compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.app K) ∧ (∀ (K L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) (v : K ⟶ L), (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.rightDerivedLowerShriek k₀ l f c ⋙ (IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l Y)).mapDerivedCategory).map v ≫ (compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.app L = (compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.app K ≫ ((IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ ordinaryCompactSupport (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).map v)
